messages:
marta: quick copy review — noticed two small UX nits in the model dropdown and the quota toast. grabbing eyeballs before I ship. screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/snap123
sam: thanks — can you call out exact lines you want tweaked? I can patch in i18n keys.
jax: saw the screenshot. the dropdown helper text currently reads: "Choose a model (default: latest)" — feels vague about what latest means in dedicated/private contexts.
aria: also accessibility nit: the helper is not announced when the dropdown opens, since it's visually inlined but not in the aria-describedby for the select.
marta: proposed copy for the helper: "Model to serve responses; use “latest” for automatic minor updates, or pin a version for reproducible outputs."
jax: I like the second clause. shorter variant for small screens: "Model to serve responses. “Latest” auto-updates; pin to freeze."
sam: is "auto-updates" too technical for some users? maybe "receives updates"?
aria: accessibility ok with either phrase. main thing: add aria-describedby pointing to helper id and ensure focus order includes it.
marta: agreed. jax can you add id and wire aria-describedby -> #model-helper in the select? also add translation key: models.dropdown.helper
jax: yes. quick patch: in React: <select aria-describedby="model-helper">...<small id="model-helper">Model to serve responses. “Latest” receives updates; pin to freeze.</small></select>
sam: second nit — rate limit toast we show after hitting per-minute tokens. current toast text: "Rate limit exceeded. Try again later." — we should give clearer guidance and alternative (e.g., retry after Xs or contact support for higher quota).
marta: proposed toast content: "You've hit the per-minute token limit. Try again in a few seconds, or request a higher quota from Support."
aria: accessibility: toasts should have role="status" and announce the ETA text if present: "Try again in 12s". Also ensure color contrast of error toast meets AA.
jax: question — do we have the server ETA available? backend returns retry_after in seconds.
sam: yes backend sends retry_after when throttled. ui can interpolate: "Try again in {retry_after}s" and fall back to "a few seconds".
marta: nice. can we also include a tiny CTA link in the toast: "Request quota" which opens support flow? maybe too heavy in toast.
aria: link is fine if it's keyboard focusable and has accessible name "Request higher quota". but avoid primary action in transient toast (a11y + accidental clicks). prefer a subtle link.
jax: implementation plan: update dropdown helper copy, wire aria-describedby, update toast copy to include retry_after when present and a subtle "Request higher quota" link. PR later today.
marta: perfect. will update the design tokens (small-screen variant) and add copy strings to the translation sheet. tagging @sam to coordinate i18n.
sam: got it. I'll add keys: models.dropdown.helper, toast.rate_limit.message, toast.rate_limit.cta
design-bot: Deployed branch preview for the dropdown copy changes: https://preview.redwood.app/changes/324 — Visual QA invited.
marta: thanks all — leaving this thread open for any last microcopy tweaks. if no objections by EOD I'll merge the PR.
aria: LGTM from accessibility side, left one comment on contrast in the preview.
jax: made contrast tweak and small-screen truncation fix. thanks!
sam: merging after CI passes. :rocket:
